ruleDefinitions.name: Potential RDP Tunneling Via Plink
ruleDefinitions.description: Execution of plink to perform data exfiltration and tunneling

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\plink\\\.exe$") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:127\\\.0\\\.0\\\.1\\:3389.*")) OR ((process_path = RGX("\\\\plink\\\.exe$") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:3389.*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-P\\ 443.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-P\\ 22.*")))
